notes: Unity driving game Ralli by JereNurminen (MIT, Copyright 2026 Jere Nurminen). Complete Unity 6000.0.45f1 project under Ralli/ with playable scene Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings (Assets/Scenes/RoadPieceAuthoring.unity is an editor authoring scene and is not in the build list). Official Unity registry/builtin packages in Ralli/Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (URP 17.0.4, Input System 1.14.2, Animation Rigging 1.3.1, AI Navigation 2.0.6, Splines 2.8.3, Timeline 1.8.7, uGUI 2.0.0, Visual Scripting 1.9.6, Multiplayer Center 1.0.0, collab-proxy, IDE packages, test framework, and built-in modules). Also lists a git dependency com.coplaydev.unity-mcp (CoplayDev/unity-mcp, MIT, pinned hash c4393b091e932835acfa6cda6ead8126f530dade) used as an editor AI-bridge; it is not vendored into this snapshot. No TextMesh Pro, no bundled fonts, no EmojiOne, no DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Library/Logs/LFS/DLL. README and docs/third-party-assets.md credit Quaternius Textured LowPoly Trees (CC0-1.0); the pack itself lives in gitignored Ralli/Assets/ThirdParty/ and is not present in this commit, only project-side Materials/Trees fallback materials. Prefabs/GasStation.prefab references a gitignored PSX Gas Station Pack (kyjhi; pack not included). Other third-party audio/vehicle packs listed in that doc are Evaluating only and are not in the repository. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~3.6M src snapshot.
